Container.Name: Gibsons-Broadband-Monitor
Container.Overview: Gibson's Broadband Monitor is a self-hosted internet speed and reliability monitor with a modern dashboard available in 16 languages. Features include automatic browser-language detection, scheduled download/upload/ping tests, historical graphs, 30-day speed statistics, outage tracking and optional phone notifications.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: speedtest broadband internet speed connection monitoring uptime outage latency graphs statistics multilingual multi-language translations notifications alerts
Container.Description: Self-hosted broadband monitoring for Unraid and Docker. The dashboard supports 16 languages, including Japanese, Simplified and Traditional Chinese, Swedish and major European languages, with automatic browser-language detection and manual selection. Includes scheduled download/upload/latency tests, interactive history charts, 30-day average/minimum/maximum speed and latency statistics, uptime and outage logs, CSV export, and optional ntfy notifications for outages, recovery and low speeds. Measurements remain in local persistent SQLite storage; no cloud account required. Beta release.
